column2: A little broom!|It slides to Gail.
column3: A tiny broom slides across the floor.|It stops by Gail.
column4: A tiny broomstick charm slides across Gail’s bedroom floor.|It stops beside her slippers, as if it has brought a message.
column5: 一把小掃帚！|它滑向瑜瑜。
column6: 小掃帚滑過地板。|它停在瑜瑜身旁。
column7: 迷你掃帚吊飾滑過瑜瑜房間的地板。|它停在拖鞋旁，彷彿帶來了一個訊息。

column3: The broom stops and glows.|Gail sees a new place.
column4: Only after the charm stops does a sparkle rise from its handle.|The lights swirl into a doorway to a school on a castle roof.
column6: 掃帚停下來，發出光芒。|瑜瑜看見一個新地方。
column7: 吊飾停穩後，一點光才從把手升起。|光點旋轉，變成通往城堡屋頂學校的入口。

column2: Here is Mira.|She is a witch.
column3: Mira is a little witch.|She watches the other pupils fly.
column4: At the school, Gail meets a little witch named Mira.|Mira watches the other pupils fly while she keeps both feet on the ground.
column5: 這是米拉。|她是一位小女巫。
column6: 米拉是一位小女巫。|她看著其他學生飛行。
column7: 在學校裡，瑜瑜遇見名叫米拉的小女巫。|米拉看著其他學生飛行，自己的雙腳仍留在地上。

column2: It is high.|“I can’t,” says Mira.
column3: The pupils fly high.|Mira feels unsure. “I can’t do that.”
column4: The other pupils fly higher than Mira wants to go.|“I can’t do that,” she says in a whisper, pulling her broom close.
column6: 學生們飛得很高。|米拉沒有把握。「我做不到。」
column7: 其他學生飛得比米拉想嘗試的高度還高。|「我做不到。」她小聲說，把掃帚拉近身邊。

column3: The teacher shows Mira what to do.|“Hold the broom. Look ahead.”
column4: The teacher begins the lesson on the ground.|She shows Mira where to hold the broom and how to look ahead before trying a simple spell.
column6: 老師示範給米拉看。|「握住掃帚，看前面。」
column7: 老師從地面開始上課。|她先示範握掃帚的位置和看前方的方法，再試簡單的咒語。

column3: Mira says the short chant.|She lifts up, but the broom wobbles.
column4: Mira repeats the short chant and rises a little above the ground.|Then the broom begins to wobble, and she forgets to look ahead.
column6: 米拉念出短短的咒語。|她升起來了，但掃帚搖搖晃晃。
column7: 米拉重複短短的咒語，離開地面一點點。|接著掃帚開始搖晃，她忘了看前方。

column2: Down she comes.|The cushion is soft.
column3: Mira lands on a soft cushion.|“I can’t,” she says again.
column4: The teacher guides Mira down onto a thick cushion.|Mira is safe, but she pushes the broom away after her first attempt.
column5: 她降下來了。|墊子軟軟的。
column6: 米拉落在軟墊上。|「我不會。」她又說。
column7: 老師引導米拉落到厚厚的墊子上。|米拉很安全，但第一次嘗試後，她把掃帚推開了。

column3: “You went up a little,” says Gail.|Mira looks at her broom.
column4: “You lifted off the ground,” Gail reminds her.|Mira did not finish the flight, but that small lift was real progress.
column6: 「妳剛剛升起來一點點了。」瑜瑜說。|米拉看看她的掃帚。
column7: 「妳離開地面了。」瑜瑜提醒她。|米拉還沒完成飛行，但那一小段升高是真正的進步。

column2: Four little cards.|One step at a time.
column3: The teacher puts out four cards.|Mira can try one small step first.
column4: The teacher lays out four picture cards: hold, hover, turn, and land.|Each card shows one skill, so Mira does not have to learn everything at once.
column6: 老師放出四張卡片。|米拉可以先試一個小步驟。
column7: 老師排出四張圖卡：握好、懸停、轉彎和降落。|每張卡片只教一項技巧，米拉不用一次學會全部。

column3: Mira copies the teacher’s grip.|Today she can start right here.
column4: Mira watches the teacher’s hands and tries to copy the grip.|This time, her task is simply to hold the broom firmly while staying on the ground.
column5: 像這樣握住。|米拉試試看。
column6: 米拉照著老師的方法握好。|今天她可以從這裡開始。
column7: 米拉觀察老師的雙手，試著模仿握法。|這次她的任務只是留在地面，把掃帚握穩。

column3: Mira hovers near the ground.|She counts to three and comes down.
column4: Mira lifts a little and holds the broom steady for three counts.|She learns to hover close to the ground before making a gentle landing.
column6: 米拉在靠近地面的地方懸停。|她數到三，再降下來。
column7: 米拉升高一點，穩穩握著掃帚數了三下。|她先學會靠近地面懸停，再輕輕降落。

column3: Mira stays up a little longer.|The broom still moves a bit.
column4: On her next try, Mira stays in the air a little longer.|The broom is almost steady, and a small wobble no longer makes her give up.
column5: 她停在空中了！|快穩住了。
column6: 米拉在空中多停留了一會兒。|掃帚還是會動一點。
column7: 下一次嘗試時，米拉在空中停留得更久。|掃帚快穩住了，小小的搖晃不再讓她放棄。

column3: “I can’t do it yet,” says Mira.|She picks up her broom again.
column4: “I can’t fly the whole course yet,” Mira says.|That last word leaves room for another try, so she picks up her broom again.
column6: 「我還不會。」米拉說。|她再次拿起掃帚。
column7: 「我還不會飛完整條路線。」米拉說。|最後那個「還」字留出了再次嘗試的空間，所以她又拿起掃帚。

column3: Mira flies toward a low hoop.|She goes through it slowly.
column4: The teacher sets the first hoop low enough for Mira to feel safe.|Mira looks ahead and passes through, using the skill she has practiced.
column5: 一個低低的圈。|米拉穿過去了！
column6: 米拉飛向低低的圈。|她慢慢穿過去。
column7: 老師把第一個圈設在讓米拉感到安全的低處。|米拉看向前方，運用練過的技巧穿過圈。

column3: Mira turns toward the next hoop.|She moves her hands a little.
column4: The next hoop is slightly to one side.|Mira makes a small turn and passes through it, noticing what her hands need to do.
column6: 米拉轉向下一個圈。|她稍微調整雙手。
column7: 下一個圈稍微偏向一側。|米拉小幅轉彎，穿過圈，留意雙手需要怎麼調整。

column3: A breeze moves the broom.|The teacher helps Mira land.
column4: A breeze makes Mira’s broom wobble again.|The teacher gives the landing signal, and Mira comes down before starting another turn.
column6: 微風吹動掃帚。|老師幫米拉降落。
column7: 一陣微風讓米拉的掃帚再次搖晃。|老師給出降落的訊號，米拉先降下來，再準備下一次轉彎。

column3: Mira tries the turn again.|She goes slowly and looks ahead.
column4: Mira takes a breath and tries the turn once more.|She does not need to fly faster; she needs time to notice and adjust.
column6: 米拉再試一次轉彎。|她慢慢飛，看著前方。
column7: 米拉吸一口氣，再次嘗試轉彎。|她不需要飛得更快，而是需要時間觀察和調整。

column3: Mira flies one small loop.|She lands safely. She did it!
column4: Mira completes a low loop and lands safely on the cushion.|She feels capable now, because she knows the small steps that helped her succeed.
column5: 她繞了一圈！|她降下來了。
column6: 米拉飛完一個小圈。|她安全降落。她做到了！
column7: 米拉完成一個低空小圈，安全落在墊子上。|她現在有了把握，因為她知道哪些小步驟幫她成功。

column3: Mira gives the cards to a new pupil.|“Try one step,” she says.
column4: A new beginner watches the flying pupils with an unsure smile.|Mira shares the practice cards and tells her, “You can begin with just one step.”
column5: 一位新朋友！|「試一個步驟。」
column6: 米拉把卡片給新學生。|「試一個步驟。」她說。
column7: 一位新手帶著沒把握的笑容，看著飛行的學生。|米拉分享練習卡，告訴她：「妳可以只從一步開始。」

column2: The light rests.|“Not yet,” says Gail.
column3: Gail is back in her room.|She puts the tiny broom by her book.
column4: Back in her room, Gail places the broom charm beside her book as its light fades.|She remembers that progress can begin with a small step and one hopeful word: yet.
column5: 光芒停歇了。|「還不會。」瑜瑜說。
column6: 瑜瑜回到房間。|她把小掃帚放在書旁。
column7: 回到房間後，瑜瑜把掃帚吊飾放在書旁，看著光芒漸漸消退。|她記得，進步可以從一小步和一個充滿希望的「還」字開始。
